recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. If Patient Care wants richer examples or revised wording for the CarePlan/EpisodeOfCare comparison, handle it as a new work-group decision rather than as remaining FHIR-5970 application work.
issue_request: FHIR-5970 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care clarification asking the spec to differentiate EpisodeOfCare and CarePlan because both can involve care teams, conditions, and activities. The accepted resolution called for Boundaries and Relationships clarification and identified EpisodeOfCare as tracking rather than planning, without requiring a CarePlan.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-5970 commit was found. Git pickaxe and blame identify 210464f33855dbfab3be8305d006cb34f638cf87, committed 2015-03-25, as adding the exact EpisodeOfCare-versus-CarePlan paragraph to source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-introduction.xml; that paragraph remains in current source.
additional_context: CarePlan and EpisodeOfCare are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. CarePlan source describes intended actions and grouping of activities, goals, and participants; EpisodeOfCare source says the resource often precedes CarePlan, is a tracking resource rather than a planning resource, and can be used without a CarePlan. The related FHIR-6131 audit is already on the combined branch, and FHIR-54402 later reaffirmed that direct CarePlan/EpisodeOfCare linkage belongs to the workflow-episodeOfCare extension. A 2020 Zulip thread adds nuance but no final reversal.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The build-scope EpisodeOfCare Boundaries and Relationships text already contains the accepted clarification, and adding duplicate CarePlan prose or changing linkage would be redundant or contrary to later decisions.

related_jiras.note: Separate Published issue about linking CarePlan to EpisodeOfCare; already represented by combined commit ceac5b5bb3e54676be9212123ca71d98f0abb643 and supports not reopening direct linkage for FHIR-5970.
Later R6 Resolved - No Change issue reaffirmed that CarePlan-to-EpisodeOfCare linkage is via workflow-episodeOfCare.
Separate care-team guidance issue explains related overlap but was not needed to decide this boundary clarification.
